column3: Why did this happen?\nDo you know?{end_now}
I see...{pause_20_skippable} So it's because\nthey hurt the holy tree?{end_wait}
I see...\nNo one could have known.{end_wait}
I don't know, Tret.\nBut they're still alive.{end_wait}
Your curse couldn't\nchange them into trees.\nTheir power stopped it.{end_wait}
What if they can help?\nThe villagers are still\ntrapped under your curse.{end_wait}
Even if Kolima is freed,\nwe're still dying, Tret.\nThat hasn't changed.{end_wait}

Kolima cut into me.
I remember every blow.{page_break}Let them stand as trees.
Let them learn what it
means to be helpless.{end_wait}
Please listen, travelers.\nTret and I are dying.{end_wait}
If we wither away,\nthis whole forest\nwill die with us.{end_wait}
Then Kolima dies, too.\nThey will not outlive me,\nLaurel.{end_wait}
Tret once protected\nthis forest. He would\nnever have wished this.{end_wait}
His heart is torn.\nThe anger is all\nthat answers now.{end_wait}
That anger became a curse.\nIt turned Kolima's people\ninto trees.{end_wait}
The kind Tret is still\nsomewhere inside him.\nBut I can't reach him.{end_wait}
Hroom! Kindness did nothing\nwhen their axes fell.{page_break}I won't give them\nanother chance.{end_wait}

There is another side
to Tret, buried beneath
his anger.{page_break}Help him find it.
It's the only way
to break this curse.{end_wait}
Please don't leave him.\nIf he dies, Kolima\nwill never be free.{end_wait}
Go deep into the forest.\nFind Tret while you can.{end_wait}

Enough, Laurel.
No human can be trusted.{page_break}I'd sooner die
than put my life
in their hands.{end_wait}
I expected more from you,\n{actor_name:1}...{pause_20_skippable} How can you\ngive up so easily?{end_wait}
You came back... Tret's\nvoice is almost gone.{page_break}When he dies,\nthese woods die with him.{end_wait}
Please. Leave while\nthere's still time.{end_wait}
The roots obey me now.\nSo does this forest.{end_wait}
Let Kolima wither.\nThey watched us die\nand kept on cutting.{end_wait}
You came looking\nfor the gentle old Tret?\nHe's gone.{end_wait}
You had your warning.\nNow you'll never leave.{end_wait}
Your power held the curse\nback out there.{page_break}Here, even the ground\nanswers to me.{end_wait}
You'll take root here,\njust like the others.\nThen you'll rot.{end_wait}
I remember the axes.\nThen nothing but anger.{end_wait}
Thank you. I couldn't bear\nto die as that thing.{end_wait}
My roots are failing.\nThere's little time left.{page_break}Go. I'll remember\nwhat you did for me.{end_wait}
If you've come to save me,\nI'm afraid you're too late.{end_now}
Then I must free them.\nThey won't die\nfor my anger.{end_wait}
I can't reach them.\nMy strength won't carry\nthat far anymore.{end_wait}
Your branches are moving.\nThe forest is healing!{end_wait}
Fair warning: there's a\nbad sickness going around.{page_break}Keep your hood up and\nyour hands clean.{end_wait}
I don't know you. Are\nyou sure you're not\nlying to me?{end_wait}

{actor_name:4} is a gifted
healer.{page_break}I'm one of her
apprentices. She teaches
me everything.{page_break}She can be stern. But
she means well.{end_wait}
